messages:
Tess: Handing off GreenCove POC - they need private VPC deployment and must preserve client source IP for backend auth. Also want a single outbound IP to add to their firewall. What architecture do we recommend?

Ibrahim: Two options: PrivateLink + customer NAT (simplest, keeps client IP on our logs) or cross-account VPC peering + our egress proxy with reserved EIPs (gives them our static IP). Peering needs CIDR coordination and route updates.

Liam: Minimal ports: outbound TCP 443 to our service or to our pinned EIP; DNS 53 to their resolver; optional NTP. For PrivateLink, they create an interface endpoint and allow inbound 443 from app subnets.

Tess: Security asked about X-Forwarded-For if we proxy. Do we include original IP in headers?

Ibrahim: Yes, our proxy adds X-Forwarded-For and we can surface original IP in audit logs. But their network firewall will see the proxy IP, not the client IP.

net-bot: Created ticket GC-POC-77: "GreenCove privatedeploy egress decision" assigned to Liam.

Liam: Action: I'll check if infra can reserve a small EIP block for the POC (ETA 6 hours) and post the exact IPs and SG snippet.

Tess: Great - I'm scheduling a 15-min call with their network engineer tomorrow 10:30 PT. Bring the IPs and the runbook.
